name: Dual-Repo Loader Manifest & Catalog Builder

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main", "master" ]
    paths-ignore:
      - "final_qc.json"
      - "spd_manifest.json"
      - "main.json"
      - "appcatlog.json"
      - "report.txt"
      - "report.json"
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 3 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build-manifests:
    name: Build Dual-Repo Manifests (NUT + Qualcomm_Loaders)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20

    steps:
      - name: Checkout ZarNiTho/NUT
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Checkout ZarNiTho/Qualcomm_Loaders
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: ZarNiTho/Qualcomm_Loaders
          path: _qcom_loaders
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Setup Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Run Dual-Repo Manifest Indexer (.elf/.mbn/.bin/.melf)
        run: |
          python3 scripts/build_final_manifest.py \
            --nut-dir . \
            --qcom-dir _qcom_loaders \
            --nut-repo "${{ github.repository }}" \
            --qcom-repo "ZarNiTho/Qualcomm_Loaders" \
            --branch "${{ github.ref_name || 'main' }}"

      - name: Cleanup Temp Clone & Validate Generated JSON
        run: |
          rm -rf _qcom_loaders
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          for fn in ("final_qc.json", "spd_manifest.json", "main.json", "appcatlog.json"):
              with open(fn, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                  data = json.load(f)
              print(f"OK {fn}: top-keys={list(data.keys())}")
          PY

      - name: Commit & Push Manifests
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add final_qc.json spd_manifest.json main.json appcatlog.json report.txt
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "Manifests already up to date."
          else
            git commit -m "chore: rebuild dual-repo manifests (NUT + Qualcomm_Loaders) [skip ci]"
            git pull --rebase origin "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" || true
            git push origin "HEAD:${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
          fi
